edibles.heading: Edibles
paragraphs: Blouds Dispensary is the downtown Brampton shop on Queen Street West at 117 Queen St W. It is open 24 hours. This is the Queen Street store, not the Hillcrest and Kennedy location. If you are already on Queen Street West, this is the edible counter for that block.

Edibles are sealed cannabis foods and drinks. You shop them by pack name, flavour, format, and the milligram details on the label. That is not the same as choosing flower or a vape. Open the live edible menu, then match those names to the packs on the shelf. If a pack is not labelled to match the page, ask before you take it.

Posted prices can change. The live menu is the current reference. Because listings move, treat the page as a planning tool, then confirm in the store. Downtown hours at this door are 24 hours, which helps if you are already on Queen Street late.

Walk in at 117 Queen St W any hour. No appointment is required. Bring government-issued photo ID. Adults 19 and older only. Ask staff for the edible section and compare labelled packs during your visit.
If you are meeting someone downtown, send 117 Queen St W and the word edibles. That keeps the group off Hillcrest and on the correct Queen Street counter.
Queen Street West in downtown Brampton is the address. Hillcrest Avenue is a different store.

vape-disposables.heading: THC Vapes
paragraphs: Blouds Dispensary is at 117 Queen St W in downtown Brampton, open 24 hours on Queen Street West. It is not the Hillcrest and Kennedy store. THC vapes are the vapour-product category at this Queen Street address.

THC vapes are sealed cannabis vapour items listed by brand, flavour notes, and posted potency. Formats change with the menu. Check the live menu for current formats rather than assuming a particular hardware style will be in the case. Write down the listed names if you are walking over from another Queen Street stop.
Posted prices can change. Use the live menu to plan, then confirm the same names at the counter. A Hillcrest vape list is not this store’s list.
Walk in at 117 Queen St W whenever you are downtown. Bring valid photo ID. You must be 19 or older. Staff can open the vape section and help you read what is labelled that visit.

If you only know you want a vapour product, start on the live vape page and note the listed names. At the counter, ask for those names. Check the live menu for current formats instead of guessing what hardware is in the case. The Queen Street list is the only list that applies here.
Stay on Queen Street West for this store. Unit 104 on Hillcrest is Kennedy Loud, not Blouds.

concentrates.heading: Concentrates
paragraphs: Blouds Dispensary is the 24-hour Queen Street West store at 117 Queen St W in downtown Brampton. It is a separate shop from Kennedy Loud at 49 Hillcrest Ave, Unit 104. Concentrates here are the extract listings on the Queen Street menu.

Concentrates are packaged cannabis extracts. Listings usually show name, extract style, listed potency, and pack weight. That is a different read than flower tiers or edible packs. Start with the live concentrate menu, then look for the same names in the store. Keep the Queen Street page open while you wait so the names stay in front of you.
Posted prices can change. An older list is not a stock promise. Confirm what you care about at the counter. If you only have one extract in mind, ask for that labelled pack first.
Walk in at 117 Queen St W. No appointment. Bring government-issued photo ID. The store serves adults 19+. Ask for the concentrate section and compare labelled items in person.

If you arrived downtown with a short extract list from another night, refresh it on the live menu before you queue. Blouds posts its own Queen Street list. Confirm the labelled pack matches the name you came in with. If it does not, pick from what is labelled that visit.
Downtown Brampton and Queen Street West are the landmarks for this location.
